responsibility: Declares the core GIMPLE and PHI iterator types and the inline traversal/editing API used by middle-end passes. It defines gimple_stmt_iterator and gphi_iterator, iterator update modes, sequence and basic-block navigation helpers, nondebug and nonvirtual-PHI traversal helpers, and the public insertion/replacement/removal/move interfaces implemented in gimple-iterator.cc.
same_name_distinction: Defines the gimple_stmt_iterator and gphi_iterator data structures, update modes, and inline navigation helpers, and declares editing operations that are implemented in the .cc file.
